messages.author: cd8a02b90e537c02
messages.subject: Expressions in boxplot labels
parts:
Hello,

Is it possible to put expressions in boxplot labels? Thanks to a
previous post, I know how to put them in legends, but similar
modifications to scale_x_discrete() don't seem to produce the expected
result. Here is a simple example:

dat=data.frame(classname=c(rep("A",5),rep("B", 5)), x=rep(1:5,2),
y=c(5+rnorm(5),3+rnorm(5)))

labs=list(expression(C[A]),expression(C[B]))
brks=c("A","B")

p = ggplot(dat,aes(x=x,y=y,fill=classname))

p + geom_boxplot() +
scale_fill_manual(values=1:2,breaks=brks,labels=labs) +
scale_x_discrete(breaks=brks,labels=labs) +
opts(legend.position="none")


Thanks in advance for the help,

Chris Gast

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Expressions in boxplot labels
parts:
Following up on a reply to a similar post today,
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/b2eaf199f3c4b354
is this what you're after?

ggplot(dat,aes(x=classname, y=y, fill=classname)) +
geom_boxplot() +
scale_fill_manual(values=1:2,breaks=brks, legend = FALSE) +
scale_x_discrete(breaks=brks,
labels=c(expression(C[A]), expression(C[B])) )

HTH,
Dennis
